moments.title: Arsenal beat Liverpool, go top of Premier League
moments.blurb: Arsenal secured a crucial 1-0 victory against Liverpool at Anfield today, their first win there since 2012, moving them to the top of the Premier League table.

angles.name: Havertz's Heroics
angles.copy: Kai Havertz's early goal was enough to seal a massive win for Arsenal at Anfield today! The Gunners are now top of the Premier League. Title race heating up? #PremierLeague

angles.name: Anfield Curse Broken
angles.copy: After 14 long years, Arsenal have finally won at Anfield! A huge 1-0 victory over Liverpool sends them to the summit of the Premier League. What a statement!

moments.title: Strictly Halloween Results Tonight
moments.blurb: Tonight's Strictly Come Dancing results show, following the Halloween special, will reveal who leaves after a shocking triple dance-off. Lawrence Robb and Jowita Przystał were eliminated after the judges unanimously voted them out.

angles.name: Triple Dance-Off Drama
angles.copy: The Halloween special brought a Strictly first: a triple dance-off! Who faced the music last night, and who survived to dance another week? Find out in tonight's results show!

angles.name: Lacey Turner on Top
angles.copy: Lacey Turner and Vito Coppola topped the Strictly Halloween leaderboard with a dazzling Charleston! Can they keep that momentum going? Tune in for the results tonight.

moments.title: Mariah Carey Declares Christmas Season OPEN
moments.blurb: Mariah Carey has officially kicked off the Christmas season today, November 1st, with her annual video declaring 'it's time!'

angles.name: It's Time!

angles.name: Queen of Christmas Returns
angles.copy: The Queen of Christmas has spoken! Mariah Carey dropped her annual 'it's time!' video today. Are you ready for Christmas music to take over the airwaves?

moments.title: Champions League Matchday 4 Kicks Off
moments.blurb: Matchday 4 of the UEFA Champions League takes place this week, November 3-4, featuring major UK clubs like Manchester United, Aston Villa, Manchester City, and Arsenal.

angles.name: European Nights Return

angles.name: Man Utd vs Roma

moments.title: Stevie Wonder Live in London
moments.blurb: Music legend Stevie Wonder is performing at The O2 in London on November 3rd and 5th, celebrating '50 years of Songs In The Key Of Life'.

angles.name: Stevie Wonder at The O2
angles.copy: An absolute icon is in London this week! Stevie Wonder brings '50 years of Songs In The Key Of Life' to The O2 on Nov 3rd & 5th. What a show that will be!

angles.name: Living Legend
angles.copy: If you're lucky enough to have tickets, prepare for a masterclass! Stevie Wonder is playing London's O2 this week. A true living legend.

angles.name: Carnaby Lights ON

moments.title: Bonfire Night Celebrations Across UK

angles.name: Local Firework Displays
angles.copy: Many towns across the UK, including Wales and Devon, are holding firework displays this week for Bonfire Night! Check local listings for timings and locations near you.
